V. 4.
He ſaid. Have he not read—So inſtead of contradicting him, our LORD confutes them by 〈◊〉 very Words of Moſes. He who made them, made them male and female from the beginning—〈◊〉
•eaſt from the Beginning of the Moſaic Creation. And where do we read of any other? Does it not follow, that GOD's making Eve was part of his Original Deſign, and not a Conſequence of Adam's beginning to fall? By making them One Man and One Woman, he condemned Polygamy: By making them One F••ſh. he condemned Divorce.
